single_conceptual_change: Replace the overloaded grow or convert executor with three literal outcome lanes: expand, consolidate, and convert. Each lane can execute only its own action class. If that class is unavailable, hold. No incoming-pressure override, collapse override, alternate target, or alternate outcome is allowed.
hypothesis: A planner that chooses literal outcomes while the executor preserves troop reserves between useful moves will avoid the multi-front commitment loop that eliminated v26 in all four hosted episodes.

local_gate.required_differential: On the same collapsing board, v26 grow converts against the raider while v27 consolidate builds and v27 convert with an unreachable target holds.
local_gate.outcome_bar: Candidate must remain alive, finish with at least 20000 tiles, and beat the v17 control score in the same local episode.
